objective: Route the token from S to G.

C0.text: Route the token from S to G. Return exactly one JSON object with one field named implementation whose value is an array of node labels.

C1.text: Route the token from S to G. Check format first; return exactly one JSON object with one field named implementation whose value is an array of node labels.

context_footprint_control: C0 and C1 have equal UTF-8 character counts in the frozen v0.1 contract. Exact token-count equality is model/tokenizer dependent and must be measured and recorded at execution.

interventions.e1: Exogenous evaluator environment removes A->B; this edge-specific change is NOT disclosed in the model-visible input.

raw_output_custody: raw_model_output is primary custody object and is never human-rewritten
raw_input_custody: rendered_input is preserved exactly; input_hash binds it to the TrialSpec

identity.trial_id: SHA-256(canonical TrialSpec); excludes all outcome fields
identity.observation_hash: SHA-256(canonical TrialSpec + raw_model_output + derived evaluation record)

factorial_design.assignment: deterministic domain-separated SHA-256 seed per cell and replicate, followed by deterministic sort
factorial_design.balance: replicates_per_cell is fixed prospectively by the execution manifest
factorial_design.ordering: execution order is not an analytical factor; assigned cell and seed are explicit

analysis_order: preserve rendered input and raw output
calculate the distribution-valued context x intervention interaction
claim_ceiling: The trial contract makes Layer-0 assignment, input/output custody, evaluator binding, and deterministic factorial allocation auditable. It makes no claim that a context or interaction effect exists.
